title: Welcome! Read the rules before posting
body: Trip reports, gear questions, and photos all welcome. Be kind, and leave no trace.

title: PSA: the creek crossing on the north loop is knee deep right now
body: Went through yesterday afternoon. The usual rock hop is underwater and the current is pushy in the middle. I got across with poles and wet boots, but I watched a couple turn around and I think that was the right call for them. If you're going this week, bring sandals for the crossing, unbuckle your hip belt, and go early before the snowmelt picks up in the afternoon. Should be back to normal in a week or two.

title: First time making pasta by hand, no machine. Is it supposed to be this thick?
body: Two cups of flour, three eggs, a rolling pin, and about an hour of my life. It tasted great but it's chewy, closer to a dumpling than a noodle, and they're all different widths because I cut them with a butter knife. My grandmother did this without measuring anything and I'm starting to understand why she had forearms like that. What am I doing wrong, or is this just how it goes the first time?

title: Does anyone else keep the same seats out of pure superstition
body: They offered us an upgrade this year. Closer, better angle, same price. I said no because the one season we sat somewhere else we finished last. My wife thinks I've lost it. I know it makes no sense. I'm still not moving.

title: My roommate found out how many snakes I have (it's 3)
body: She knew about one. One was in the lease conversation. The other two live in the office, which she never goes into, until yesterday when the wifi died and she went looking for the router. To her credit she closed the door very calmly. We've had a talk. They can stay as long as nobody new shows up. I didn't mention the eggs. (Kidding. Mostly.)

title: Wifi drops every night around 9. Only at 9.
body: Every night, 9pm give or take a few minutes, everything slows to a crawl for about a quarter of an hour and then it's fine again. Restarted the router, moved it off the floor, called the provider and they say the line is fine. It's too regular to be random. What would even do that?

title: Lake trail at sunrise: worth the 4am alarm
body: Left the lot at 4:40 with a headlamp for the first mile and a half. Got to the top just as the sun came over the east ridge and the whole lake went orange for about five minutes. Trail is dry except the last switchbacks, which are still muddy. Saw two other people all morning. Full report in the comments.

title: My sourdough finally has an open crumb
body: Three months of flat loaves. The trick was a wetter dough and a longer cold proof. Okay, "open" by my standards. I know it's not the lacy stuff the pros post. Sesame crust because I had sesame. I'm just happy it isn't a frisbee.

title: Laptop fan running constantly, nothing open
body: Fan is loud even when idle. Checked for updates, restarted, closed every tab I own. It's about four years old and it sits on my desk all day. Any ideas before I take it somewhere?

title: First overnight trip. What am I forgetting?
body: Tent, bag, stove, water filter, headlamp. Going out for one night next weekend, about 4 miles in. I've done plenty of day hikes but never slept out there. Be honest.

title: Made 60 crab rangoons for my grandson's graduation and they were gone in ten minutes
body: I folded every one of these by hand in front of the television. He asked for them instead of a cake, which I took as a compliment. This plate is what I hid in the kitchen for myself before the party started, and I'd do it again.

title: What's the one knife you'd keep?
body: Line cook here. Curious what home cooks actually reach for, not what the box set told you that you need.

title: PSA: back up before updating
body: Lost a week of work to an update gone wrong. It asked, I clicked yes, I went to make coffee, and I came back to a machine that didn't know who I was. Learn from me.

title: Dinner tonight
body: Simple pasta. Nothing fancy. Sausage, peppers, cream, and whatever noodles were in the cupboard. One pan, because I refuse to do dishes after 9pm.

title: The finale last night (spoilers)
body: Did NOT see that ending coming. Six seasons and they were hiding it in the first episode the whole time.

title: Okay what am I doing wrong (flat loaf, again)
body: Same recipe as everybody else here. It rises fine in the bowl, then I turn it out and it relaxes into a pancake on the stone. Tastes good, looks like a paving slab. Photo is attempt number five. I'm about ready to blame the starter.

title: Is it worth upgrading to the new phone?
body: Mine is three years old and works fine. Battery is the only complaint, it's dead by 4pm most days.

title: Sunset from the ridge
body: Stayed later than planned and walked the last two miles out by headlamp. The light on the far side of the valley went pink and then purple and I couldn't make myself leave. No regrets.

title: Free pothos cuttings, I have too many
body: It has taken over a bookshelf and part of a window. They're already rooted in water. Message me if you want some.

title: Boots or trail runners? Settle this for my hiking group
body: We've been having this argument for two years and it nearly ended a friendship on the last trip. I'm a boots person, I've rolled my ankle too many times. Half the group swears their feet have never been happier since they switched.

title: Update on the laptop fan: it was dust
body: Opened it up like someone suggested in the other thread. There was a grey mat over the whole vent. One can of compressed air later, it's silent. Posting this so the next person searching finds the answer.

title: Weeknight salad that actually fills you up
body: Roasted chickpeas, olives, parsley, and a tahini lemon sauce over the top. Not pretty, but it's dinner in 25 minutes and it's better the next day.

title: Old desktop won't boot after moving it
body: Carried it up one flight of stairs and now it powers on but nothing shows on the screen. Probably a loose cable. Will report back.

title: Powdered donut holes, second attempt
body: The first batch came out as raw-in-the-middle golf balls, so I'm not showing you those. These ones I'd give to another person. Still learning how hot the oil should be.

title: Knife sharpening myths
body: Let's talk about it. The honing steel doesn't sharpen anything, a glass cutting board is a crime, and you don't need a kit that costs more than the knife. Tell me what you were taught and I'll tell you if it's true.

title: What's a small thing that made your week?
body: Mine: the boy next door carried my groceries up without being asked, and then asked if I had any more of the rangoons.

title: Trail etiquette question: who yields on a narrow switchback?
body: Had a standoff today where both of us stepped aside at the same time, twice. I always thought uphill has the right of way but half the people I meet seem to think it's the other way round.
